notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-09-05, b3027 — the capture-failure and resumable-update fixes, notarized): Two fixes from today's reports ride this build: (1) A capture that received no audio now says so instead of guessing a language. When the microphone delivers nothing — a re-press during a notice phase used to glue a new press onto a capture whose microphone had already stopped, producing a long "recording" with zero audio — the app now says "The microphone delivered no audio — check the input device", names the device, and keeps the clip. The language safety net (the "may not match" hold) only fires when audio was actually received. A re-press during a notice phase now starts a fresh capture; a very quiet capture (level under 0.01) says the microphone level was very low and names the input device.
